headline: Internet users across Pakistan face intermittent connectivity and slow speeds after a fault in the SEA-ME-WE 5 (SMW5) submarine cable about 11 km from Pakistan's shore, the PTA said on Wednesday night, Geo News reports.

card.desc: PTA ke mutabiq SMW5 cable mein sahil se 11 km door fault

caption:
Mulk bhar mein internet slow, samundar mein cable kharab! 🌐
Geo News ke mutabiq PTA ne Wednesday raat bataya ke SEA-ME-WE 5 (SMW5) submarine cable mein Pakistan ke sahil se taqreeban 11 km door kharabi aa gayi hai. Is wajah se poore Pakistan mein internet baar baar ruk raha hai aur speed bhi kam hai. Transworld Associates (TWA) SMW5 Consortium ke saath mil kar kharabi ki wajah dhoond rahi hai, aur internet traffic doosre international links par bheja ja raha hai. Internet poori tarah kab theek hoga, yeh abhi nahi bataya gaya.
